claims.claim_ar: الفعل اتَّخَذَ (في قولهم «اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا») هو الْخَبَرُ
claims.claim_en: The verb اتَّخَذَ (in their utterance 'اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا') functions as the predicate (خبر).
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source string uses the plural form «اتَّخَذُوا», while the verse contains اتَّخَذَ; the source asserts that اتخذ is the 'خبر' but the exact syntactic configuration in this ayah (reported speech after قالوا) may have additional analyses. More contextual citations would raise confidence.
